question: Should OpenClaw adopt `local`, `container`, `reverse-proxy`, and `node-mode` as the initial named hosting-support catalog once the readiness contract is accepted?
rationale: This RFC adds a new user-facing deployment and support contract rather than repairing established behavior, and the available review context does not show an existing maintainer decision on that boundary.

options.title: Adopt the four-profile catalog
options.body: Accept the direction and require its runtime implementation to remain opt-in with release conformance coverage.

options.title: Adopt readiness only
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/33 independent and defer named hosting profiles until deployment needs are clearer.

options.title: Narrow the initial catalog
options.body: Request a smaller first set before committing to reverse-proxy and paired-node support contracts.

recommendation.title: Adopt the four-profile catalog
recommendation.body: Accept the direction and require its runtime implementation to remain opt-in with release conformance coverage.
